scenarios.prompt: A hub level has three spokes and a locked shortcut. Define spatial metrics, visible route choices and gate reasons before final art.

criteria.ownership: Owns spatial structure/pacing/gates, not greybox implementation or map UI.

criteria.evidence: Representative routes record choice points, timing, gates and sightlines.
